entities.name: Exava
entities.description: Leader of the bloodwitches of the Cult of Rakdos, former acting leader for the Defiler and maze-runner, enemy of Emmara Tandris.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild of Ravnica Exava belongs to.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Maze run in which Exava was the Rakdos maze-runner.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: Place where Exava showed up hoping to wreak havoc.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Linked the maze-runners' minds, becoming the Living Guildpact; later confronted Exava.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Triggered when Jace linked the maze-runners' minds, making him Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: Role of Ravnica's guildpact holder, which Jace became.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon leader of the Cult of Rakdos, who replaced Exava with Hekara as his representative.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rakdos's emissary, killed and revived as a bloodwitch; later his official representative.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Leader of a group persuading guilds to help Niv-Mizzet's plan.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon whose plan was to become the new guildpact.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who confronted Exava with Jace.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Target of the Living Guildpact's order to kill.

events.summary: Exava completes the Implicit Maze as the Rakdos maze-runner and shows up at the Forum of Azor hoping to wreak havoc.
events.quote: She completed the run successfully and showed up at the Forum of Azor hoping to wreak havoc.

events.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Living Guildpact.
events.quote: which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact

events.summary: Hekara is revived as a bloodwitch and agrees to help Kaya's group; Exava objects but loses to Hekara in a fight.
events.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

events.summary: After the War, Jace and Chandra confront Exava because Jace needs someone to mind read without guilt; they learn of the order to kill Liliana Vess.
events.quote: they found out about the new Living Guildpact 's order to kill Liliana Vess

events.summary: Rakdos replaces Exava with Hekara as his official representative.
events.quote: Rakdos replaced Exava with Hekara as his official representative

relations.quote: Exava is the leader of the bloodwitches of the Cult of Rakdos
